note: severity: critical > high > medium > low. platform: web | mobile | all. auto names the check in design_spec_checker.py that tests the rule against a token file; null means review by hand.

rules.rule: Body text reaches 4.5:1 contrast against its background (7:1 for AAA).
rules.why: Below this, low-vision and glare-affected readers lose the text.
rules.check: Compute the ratio for every text/background pair in both modes.

rules.rule: Secondary and muted text also reaches 4.5:1; it is not exempt for being less important.
rules.why: Muted text usually carries timestamps, hints and errors people need.
rules.check: Ratio of muted text against background and against surface.

rules.rule: Controls, input borders and focus indicators reach 3:1 against adjacent colours.
rules.why: WCAG 1.4.11: users must be able to see where a control is.
rules.check: Ratio of primary and focus colour against background.

rules.rule: Text on coloured fills (buttons, badges, banners) reaches 4.5:1.
rules.why: White on mid-blue or mid-orange is the most common real-world failure.
rules.check: on_primary vs primary, on_accent vs accent, on_danger vs danger.

rules.rule: Every interactive element shows a visible focus indicator at least 2px thick.
rules.why: Keyboard and switch users navigate by focus alone.
rules.check: Tab through the page; token focus width >= 2.

rules.rule: Colour is never the only carrier of meaning; pair it with text, icon or pattern.
rules.why: About 1 in 12 men have a colour vision deficiency.
rules.check: View in greyscale; every status still reads.

rules.rule: Icon-only buttons have an accessible name.
rules.why: Screen readers announce an unnamed button as 'button'.
rules.check: Inspect aria-label / accessibilityLabel on every icon button.

rules.rule: Headings form a logical outline with one h1 and no skipped levels.
rules.why: Screen-reader users jump by heading.
rules.check: Run a heading outline tool.

rules.rule: Text scales to 200% (or OS large text) without loss of content.
rules.why: WCAG 1.4.4 and native Dynamic Type users.
rules.check: Zoom to 200% / largest accessibility size and look for clipping.

rules.rule: Focused elements are never fully hidden behind sticky headers, footers or banners.
rules.why: WCAG 2.2 focus-not-obscured.
rules.check: Tab through with sticky elements visible; set scroll-padding.

rules.rule: Dragging actions have a single-pointer alternative.
rules.why: WCAG 2.2 dragging movements; tremor and switch users.
rules.check: Every reorder/slider has buttons or keyboard input.

rules.rule: A skip link leads to the main content.
rules.why: Keyboard users should not tab through the whole nav on every page.
rules.check: First Tab press reveals 'Skip to content'.

rules.rule: Touch targets are at least 44x44pt (iOS) or 48x48dp (Android); never below 24x24 CSS px on web.
rules.why: Small targets cause mis-taps, especially one-handed or on the move.
rules.check: Token touch_target >= 44; measure hit areas, not icon size.

rules.rule: Adjacent targets have at least 8px between hit areas.
rules.why: Prevents hitting the neighbour.
rules.check: Inspect spacing between list actions and toolbar icons.

rules.rule: Nothing essential depends on hover.
rules.why: Touch devices have no hover.
rules.check: Use the product on a phone; every tooltip and menu is reachable by tap.

rules.rule: Primary actions sit in the thumb zone on phones (lower half).
rules.why: One-handed reach.
rules.check: Main call to action is reachable without regrip.

rules.rule: Custom gestures do not fight system gestures (edge swipes, home indicator).
rules.why: Users trigger the OS instead of the app.
rules.check: Test swipe-back and bottom edge on both platforms.

rules.rule: Pressed state appears within 100ms of touch, without changing the control's size or position.
rules.why: Late or jumping feedback makes people tap twice.
rules.check: Tap each control on a real device; watch for delay and layout shift.

rules.rule: Haptics confirm significant actions only and follow the system setting.
rules.why: Constant vibration becomes noise and drains attention.
rules.check: List every haptic call; each maps to a completed or failed action.

rules.rule: Every control has distinct default, hover, pressed, focus and disabled states.
rules.why: State is feedback; missing states feel broken.
rules.check: Component sheet shows all five states.

rules.rule: Destructive or irreversible actions ask for confirmation or offer undo.
rules.why: Mistakes are cheap only when reversible.
rules.check: List every delete/send/pay action and its safety net.

rules.rule: Buttons show progress and lock while their action runs.
rules.why: Prevents double submission.
rules.check: Throttle the network and click twice.

rules.rule: Frequent actions have keyboard shortcuts that are discoverable.
rules.why: Power users live on the keyboard.
rules.check: Shortcuts are listed in tooltips or a help sheet.

rules.rule: Reserve space for images, ads and embeds so layout does not shift (CLS under 0.1).
rules.why: Shifts cause mis-clicks and lost reading place.
rules.check: Width/height or aspect-ratio on every media element.

rules.rule: Serve images in modern formats at the size displayed, lazy-loading below the fold.
rules.why: Images are usually most of the page weight.
rules.check: Audit the largest five requests.

rules.rule: Load at most two webfont families and four weights in total; use font-display swap or optional.
rules.why: Each family delays text and adds weight.
rules.check: Count families and weights in the token file.

rules.rule: Blur, backdrop filters and large shadows are used on few surfaces.
rules.why: They are expensive to paint on mid-range phones.
rules.check: Count elements using backdrop-filter; profile scrolling.

rules.rule: No horizontal scrolling at 320px viewport width.
rules.why: WCAG 1.4.10 reflow; small phones.
rules.check: Resize to 320px wide.

rules.rule: Spacing comes from one scale on a 4px base grid.
rules.why: Ad-hoc values make rhythm look accidental.
rules.check: Every spacing token is a multiple of 4 (2 allowed for hairline gaps).

rules.rule: The spacing scale has no near-duplicate steps and no more than 12 values.
rules.why: Two steps 2px apart are never chosen deliberately.
rules.check: Sorted scale; each step clearly larger than the last.

rules.rule: Use at most four corner-radius values (plus 0 and fully round).
rules.why: Many radii read as many designers.
rules.check: Count distinct radius tokens.

rules.rule: Layouts mirror correctly for right-to-left languages.
rules.why: Arabic, Hebrew and Persian users read right to left.
rules.check: Use logical properties (margin-inline-start) and test dir=rtl.

rules.rule: Components tolerate 30-40% longer strings.
rules.why: German and Finnish run long; translations break fixed widths.
rules.check: Pseudo-localise and look for clipping.

rules.rule: Content respects safe areas (notch, home indicator, rounded corners).
rules.why: Controls under the notch cannot be tapped.
rules.check: Test on a device with a notch in both orientations.

rules.rule: Fixed headers, tab bars and bottom action bars add matching scroll padding so nothing hides behind them.
rules.why: The last list item or form button ends up unreachable.
rules.check: Scroll each list and form to the end with every fixed bar showing.

rules.rule: Headings and short labels avoid one-word last lines (text-wrap: balance or manual breaks).
rules.why: Orphaned words make headings look unfinished.
rules.check: View headings at 320, 768 and 1280px.

rules.rule: Body text is at least 16px on web (17pt iOS / 16sp Android); never below 12px anywhere.
rules.why: Smaller text fails on phones and for older readers.
rules.check: Token base size >= 16; smallest step >= 12.

rules.rule: Body line height is 1.4-1.7.
rules.why: Tighter lines collide; looser lines lose the next line.
rules.check: Token line_height in range.

rules.rule: Reading measure is 45-80 characters.
rules.why: Long lines make the eye lose its place.
rules.check: max-width around 65ch on prose containers.

rules.rule: Type sizes follow one ratio; every step is clearly larger than the last.
rules.why: Random sizes flatten hierarchy.
rules.check: Ratios between consecutive steps between 1.07 and 1.62.

rules.rule: Numbers in tables use tabular figures.
rules.why: Columns of figures align and compare.
rules.check: font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums on data cells.

rules.rule: All-caps is reserved for short labels with added letter spacing.
rules.why: All-caps paragraphs are slow to read.
rules.check: Search for text-transform: uppercase on long text.

rules.rule: Text follows the OS text-size setting (Dynamic Type, font scale) up to the largest accessibility size.
rules.why: Many readers rely on larger system text; fixed sizes ignore it.
rules.check: Set the largest system size and walk every screen for clipping and overlap.

rules.rule: Components reference semantic tokens (bg, fg, primary), never raw hex.
rules.why: Raw values break theming and dark mode.
rules.check: Grep component code for hex literals.

rules.rule: Dark mode is designed with its own surfaces, not an inverted light theme.
rules.why: Inverted palettes overshoot contrast and break brand colours.
rules.check: Both modes defined; each passes contrast on its own.

rules.rule: Avoid pure #FFFFFF text on pure #000000 in dark mode.
rules.why: Maximum contrast causes halation for many readers, especially with astigmatism.
rules.check: Dark bg slightly lifted (e.g. #0B0B0F) or fg slightly dimmed.

rules.rule: One action colour; accent is not reused for decoration.
rules.why: When everything is blue, nothing is clickable.
rules.check: Primary appears only on interactive elements.

rules.rule: Error text reaches 4.5:1 against the background.
rules.why: Error messages are the text people most need to read.
rules.check: danger vs bg in both modes.

rules.rule: Borders, dividers and disabled states stay visible in both modes.
rules.why: Separators tuned for light mode often vanish on dark surfaces.
rules.check: Compare border and disabled tokens against surface in each mode (3:1 for controls).

rules.rule: Scrims behind dialogs are dark enough that the dialog text meets contrast over the busiest background.
rules.why: A fixed opacity fails over photos and bright pages.
rules.check: Open each dialog over the busiest screen and measure text over the result.

rules.rule: Respect the reduced-motion setting: remove parallax, autoplay and large movement.
rules.why: Vestibular disorders make motion physically sickening.
rules.check: prefers-reduced-motion block or OS setting read; token reduced_motion true.

rules.rule: UI transitions run 100-400ms; nothing interactive waits on animation over 500ms.
rules.why: Slower feels sluggish; faster is invisible.
rules.check: Duration tokens within range.

rules.rule: Animate transform and opacity, not width, height or top.
rules.why: Layout properties trigger reflow and jank.
rules.check: Grep transitions for layout properties.

rules.rule: Nothing flashes more than three times per second.
rules.why: Photosensitive seizure risk (WCAG 2.3.1).
rules.check: Review every looping or flashing effect.

rules.rule: Auto-advancing content (carousels, tickers) can be paused.
rules.why: WCAG 2.2.2; people read at different speeds.
rules.check: Pause control present and keyboard reachable.

rules.rule: Every input has a visible label; placeholder is never the label.
rules.why: Placeholders vanish on typing and fail contrast.
rules.check: Inspect each field.

rules.rule: Errors appear next to the field, say what to do, and are announced.
rules.why: A red border alone tells nobody how to fix it.
rules.check: Submit an empty form; read each message aloud.

rules.rule: Use the right input type and autocomplete tokens.
rules.why: Correct keyboards and autofill halve typing on phones.
rules.check: type=email/tel/number, autocomplete attributes present.

rules.rule: Do not ask for the same information twice in one flow.
rules.why: WCAG 2.2 redundant entry.
rules.check: Walk the flow and list repeated fields.

rules.rule: Login allows paste and password managers; no cognitive puzzles as the only option.
rules.why: WCAG 2.2 accessible authentication.
rules.check: Paste into password and code fields.

rules.rule: Long forms show progress and save drafts.
rules.why: Lost progress is the top abandonment cause.
rules.check: Refresh mid-form.

rules.rule: Each field opens the matching keyboard (email, number, phone, URL) and Next moves to the following field.
rules.why: The wrong keyboard turns a two-second entry into a hunt.
rules.check: Tab through each form on a phone and note the keyboard each field opens.

rules.rule: Password fields offer show/hide, and sign-in accepts passkeys or the platform's saved credentials.
rules.why: Typing blind on a phone causes failed logins and resets.
rules.check: Sign in with a password manager and with a passkey on each platform.

rules.rule: Enter does not submit while an input method is composing text (CJK, Korean, Vietnamese).
rules.why: Submitting mid-composition sends half-typed words.
rules.check: Type with a CJK input method and press Enter to confirm a character.

rules.rule: Back always returns to the previous view and state.
rules.why: Broken back is the fastest way to lose trust.
rules.check: Filter, open a detail, press back.

rules.rule: Bottom navigation holds three to five destinations with labels.
rules.why: More than five becomes unreadable; icons alone are ambiguous.
rules.check: Count tabs; every tab has text.

rules.rule: Important views are deep-linkable and survive refresh.
rules.why: People share, bookmark and reload.
rules.check: Copy the URL of a filtered view into a new tab.

rules.rule: The current location is shown in navigation.
rules.why: Orientation.
rules.check: Active state visible in nav on every page.

rules.rule: Modals and sheets close with the system back gesture or button as well as a visible close control.
rules.why: People expect back to dismiss; a trapped sheet feels broken.
rules.check: Open each sheet and dismiss it with back, swipe and the close button.

rules.rule: Switching tabs keeps each tab's scroll position and unfinished input.
rules.why: Losing a half-written form when glancing at another tab punishes curiosity.
rules.check: Fill part of a form, switch tabs, return, and check nothing was lost.

rules.rule: Any wait over one second shows progress; over ten seconds shows determinate progress or lets work continue.
rules.why: Silence reads as failure.
rules.check: Throttle the network on every async action.

rules.rule: Empty states explain what belongs there and offer the first action.
rules.why: A blank screen is a dead end for new users.
rules.check: Open each list with no data.

rules.rule: Toasts stay long enough to read (at least 5s) and never carry the only copy of critical information.
rules.why: Auto-dismissed messages are missed by slow readers and screen readers.
rules.check: Time toasts; critical messages persist.

rules.rule: Errors say what happened and how to recover, in plain words.
rules.why: 'Something went wrong' helps nobody.
rules.check: Force each error path.

rules.rule: Offline and failed-sync states are shown, and queued actions say when they will be sent.
rules.why: Silent failure makes people repeat actions or lose work.
rules.check: Turn the network off mid-task and check what the screen tells you.

rules.rule: Success is confirmed where the action happened, not only in a distant toast.
rules.why: People watch the control they used, not the corner of the screen.
rules.check: Complete each main action and note where confirmation appears.

rules.rule: Dates, numbers and currencies follow the user's locale.
rules.why: 03/04 means different days in different countries.
rules.check: Switch locale and compare.

rules.rule: Truncated text can be revealed in full.
rules.why: Names and IDs cut mid-word cause errors.
rules.check: Tooltip, expand or detail view for every ellipsis.

rules.rule: Use one icon set with consistent stroke and size; no emoji as interface icons.
rules.why: Mixed sets look unfinished; emoji render differently per platform.
rules.check: Inventory icons by source.

rules.rule: Icons come in token sizes (for example 16/20/24) with one stroke width, and one style (outline or filled) per level.
rules.why: Mixed sizes and strokes read as assembled from parts.
rules.check: List icon sizes and strokes used in the codebase; anything off the scale is a finding.

rules.rule: Logos and third-party marks use the owner's official artwork, proportions and clear space.
rules.why: Redrawn or recoloured logos look counterfeit.
rules.check: Compare each logo with the owner's brand page.

rules.rule: Every metric shows its unit, period and comparison.
rules.why: A bare number cannot be judged.
rules.check: Each KPI tile has unit + period + delta.

rules.rule: Charts have a text or table alternative.
rules.why: Screen-reader users and anyone checking exact values.
rules.check: Data table toggle or summary sentence per chart.

rules.rule: Categorical colours are limited to about six and stay distinguishable under colour-blind simulation.
rules.why: Beyond six, people stop matching legend to series.
rules.check: Simulate deuteranopia and protanopia.

rules.rule: Large tables paginate or virtualise and keep headers sticky.
rules.why: Thousands of rows freeze the page and lose column meaning.
rules.check: Load the realistic maximum row count.

rules.rule: Generated output is labelled as generated and can be stopped, retried or edited.
rules.why: People need control over output they did not write.
rules.check: Stop and regenerate controls present while streaming.

rules.rule: Streaming responses do not push the input field or scroll position around.
rules.why: Layout jumps while reading are disorienting.
rules.check: Scroll up during a long response.

rules.rule: Sources and confidence are shown where the answer depends on them.
rules.why: Users over-trust fluent text.
rules.check: Answers with facts link to sources.

rules.rule: No dark patterns: no pre-ticked upsells, fake timers, confirm-shaming or hidden costs.
rules.why: They convert once and lose the customer; several are illegal in the EU and UK.
rules.check: Walk checkout and cancellation as a new user.

rules.rule: Total price, fees and renewal terms are visible before commitment.
rules.why: Surprise costs are the top reason for abandoned checkouts.
rules.check: Compare first price shown with final price.

rules.rule: Cancelling is as easy as signing up.
rules.why: Hard cancellation breeds chargebacks and complaints.
rules.check: Count steps to cancel vs to subscribe.
